notes: Overview: Gov agency overseeing port operations and coastal critical infra. Seeking on-prem/air-gapped LLM inference for operational chat + report summarization.
Primary constraints: no outbound network from inference cluster, keys must be HSM-backed, full audit trail retained for 7+ years, data classified (restricted).
"Customer quote": "We need models to run inside our secure enclave with NO internet egress — any external calls are a non-starter."

Interest: model-hosting flexibility (pin versions), deterministic fallbacks, fine-grained routing so high-priority incidents stay on higher SLAs. Cost sensitivity moderate if SLA met — procurement metric is predictable monthly burn, not just per-token costs.

Technical preference: tested with open Llama variants and smaller instruction-tuned models; will evaluate quantized runtimes; want Redwood runtime kernel selection + KV caching but must validate in-air-gap.
Security asks raised: supply chain attestation, SBOM for runtime binaries, KMS/HSM integration diagram, SOC2/ISO question list — sent security FAQ (drive link).
Procurement notes: currently under inter-agency procurement window Q2; budget holder expects a 12–24 month commitment for Dedicated or Private.
